meta.notes: A chicken variant: asset_id is the grown chicken's texture (64 by 32 pixels) and baby_asset_id the chick's (16 by 16), under textures/entity/chicken/. Its spawn condition picks flower forests with priority 1. Eggs thrown by a chicken hatch chicks of its variant. Try /summon minecraft:chicken ~ ~ ~ {variant:"msm_examples:jade_chicken"}.
